evals.name: feature-etcdopstask-snapshot-hibernation
evals.prompt: I've been assigned issue gardener/etcd-druid#445. The goal is to trigger a full snapshot via EtcdOpsTask when an etcd resource is hibernated (spec.Replicas set to 0) and also when performing an etcd version upgrade. This needs a new feature gate called UpgradeEtcdVersion. It'll touch the statefulset component, the etcd reconciler, feature gates in api/config/v1alpha1/features.go, image selection logic, helm charts, and needs both unit and integration tests. This is a large cross-cutting feature. How should I approach this?

evals.name: bugfix-etcdopstask-deletion
evals.prompt: We have a bug in the EtcdOpsTask controller. When someone force-deletes an EtcdOpsTask (kubectl delete etcdopstask <name>) before its TTL expires, the deletion doesn't work properly — the controller doesn't handle it. The deletion reconciler at internal/controller/etcdopstask/reconcile_delete.go only handles TTL-based cleanup. Also the TTL value for pre-sync etcdopstasks in the statefulset component is too short. Can you help me debug and fix this?
evals.expected_output: Should invoke /etcd-druid:debug skill, follow the systematic debugging workflow (read error, reproduce, locate, hypothesize, fix), identify the specific files (reconcile_delete.go, statefulset.go), write tests first following TDD, and plan for integration tests in test/it/controller/etcdopstask/.

assertions.text: Invokes the debug skill or follows systematic debugging steps
Identifies reconcile_delete.go as the primary fix location
Mentions writing or checking integration tests in test/it/controller/etcdopstask/
Suggests reproducing the issue before fixing (Iron Law)
Does NOT attempt multiple speculative fixes simultaneously

evals.name: enhancement-copy-final-snapshot-race
evals.prompt: During control plane migration, the backup copy operation sometimes times out even though the final snapshot was already taken and copied. Looking at the logs, what happens is: when etcd-backup-restore starts up (e.g. after shoot de-hibernation), it takes a new full snapshot that races with the final snapshot. The copy operation only checks the very latest full snapshot to see if it's the final one, but the racing snapshot may finish after the final one, pushing it out of the 'latest' position. The fix should be to check the last N full snapshots instead of just the latest. The relevant code is in pkg/snapshot/copier/copier.go and pkg/miscellaneous/miscellaneous.go. Can you help?
evals.expected_output: Should invoke /etcd-druid:plan, identify this as etcd-backup-restore enhancement, plan a new GetNLatestFullSnapshots function in miscellaneous.go, plan comprehensive tests for the new function, integrate into the copier, and use TDD (write test first for the new function).

assertions.text: Invokes plan skill before writing implementation code
Correctly identifies etcd-backup-restore as the target repo
Plans to add a new utility function (like GetNLatestFullSnapshots)
Plans test coverage for the new function
Mentions make revendor or make verify for etcd-backup-restore CI
Does NOT suggest changes to etcd-druid when the fix is in etcd-backup-restore
